ad_analyses.target_icp: Skeptical retail trader who feels manipulated by institutions
ad_analyses.hook: Are you on the right side of the crowd?
ad_analyses.offer: Free screener, no credit card required
messaging_patterns: 'When 90% do X, smart money does Y'

common_pain_points: Indicator overload and conflicting technical indicators
Buying late and serving as exit liquidity on Twitter/Reddit hype
Emotional revenge trading and moving stop losses during drawdown
Lack of objective conviction in trade direction
common_hooks: Contrarian challenge ('Are you on the wrong side of the crowd?')
Speed/Latency callout ('Why did you find out 30 minutes too late?')
common_marketing_angles: Simplification of noisy data into single decisive signal
Contrarian smart-money vs retail herd positioning
Automated discipline to remove emotion and hesitation
repeated_concepts: Before/After UI contrast (messy multi-chart screen vs single clean cockpit)
Red vs Green bar charts showing crowd polarity
Bold ticker symbols (SPY, QQQ, NVDA, BTC) with price targets
market_gaps_and_opportunities: Competitors either sell generic chart software or black-box algorithms that users don't trust.
None show transparent, verifiable crowd consensus from 16,000+ actual trader predictions.
CrowdWisdomTrading can stand out by proving consensus without selling fake '100% win rate' dreams.
crowdwisdom_adaptation_strategy: Use high-contrast Vox-style split-screen visuals showing: Retail Hype (85% Buy) vs CWT Consensus (76% Divergence).
Directly address the emotional exhaustion of solo trading.
compliance_notes: Strictly avoid any 'guaranteed profit' or 'make $1,000/day' language.
Focus on probabilistic edge, discipline, and sentiment intelligence.
